scope: Manual reading of all nine installed WAGO bodies from the complete final native assembly against every other non-wire body, including tubes, their actual printed hosts and all other WAGOs. Each selected wire-mouth approach and current PSU driver column is tested in the same full physical scene. Nominal reference envelopes and digital insertion/clearance only; no physical lever-force claim.

wago-h.purpose: C14 live / PSU primary / relay 1 COM

wago-g.purpose: C14 PE / carbonator bond / compressor earth

wago-sensors.purpose: PCB J4 / temperature bus / flow meter common

wago-v12.purpose: PSU secondary / relay 2 COM / PCB J10 V12

wago-gnd.purpose: PSU secondary / pump negative / PCB J10 GND

wago-reeds-b.purpose: PCB J7 / reservoir B / carbonator reed common

wago-mana.purpose: J1 valve common and eight A-H coil branches

wago-manb.purpose: J2 valve common, I/J/K coils and condenser fan

approach_resolution.scope: An arbitrary straight 8 mm diameter-3 probe is a diagnostic envelope, not the selected conductor route or a required insertion length. The source-bound installed wires turn after their actual terminal lands. Those complete native wire solids are clear at the two larger-body witnesses; wire-to-tube contact is excluded by the requested wire scope.

actual_native_reader.scope: Exact installed native wire solids at the two conservative straight WAGO approach witnesses. The actual curved conductor, including its terminal land, is queried against the complete named larger body. No endpoint mask or geometry change is applied. Wire-to-tube approach witnesses are outside the requested obstacle scope.
